<?php
// Read n and m
list($n, $m) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

// Read actions
$actions = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
array_unshift($actions, 0); // 1-based indexing

// Graphs
$g = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []);
$rg = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []);

// Read edges
for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    if ($line === '') { $i--; continue; }
    list($a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line));
    $g[$a][] = $b;
    $rg[$b][] = $a;
}

// Kosaraju to find SCCs
$visited = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$order = [];

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if (!$visited[$i]) {
        $stack = [[$i, 0]];
        while ($stack) {
            [$v, $state] = array_pop($stack);
            if ($state == 0) {
                if ($visited[$v]) continue;
                $visited[$v] = true;
                $stack[] = [$v, 1];
                foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
                    if (!$visited[$to]) $stack[] = [$to, 0];
                }
            } else {
                $order[] = $v;
            }
        }
    }
}

$scc_id = array_fill(0, $n + 1, -1);
$scc_count = 0;

for ($i = count($order) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $v = $order[$i];
    if ($scc_id[$v] != -1) continue;
    $stack = [$v];
    $scc_id[$v] = $scc_count;
    while ($stack) {
        $u = array_pop($stack);
        foreach ($rg[$u] as $to) {
            if ($scc_id[$to] == -1) {
                $scc_id[$to] = $scc_count;
                $stack[] = $to;
            }
        }
    }
    $scc_count++;
}

// Build SCC DAG
$scc_g = array_fill(0, $scc_count, []);
$assign = array_fill(0, $scc_count, false);
$use = array_fill(0, $scc_count, false);

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    $cid = $scc_id[$v];
    if ($actions[$v] == 1) $assign[$cid] = true;
    if ($actions[$v] == 2) $use[$cid] = true;
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        $ct = $scc_id[$to];
        if ($ct != $cid) {
            $scc_g[$cid][$ct] = true; // use associative to avoid duplicates
        }
    }
}

// Convert adjacency sets to lists
for ($i = 0; $i < $scc_count; $i++) {
    $scc_g[$i] = array_keys($scc_g[$i]);
}

// Topological order of SCC DAG (Kahn)
$indeg = array_fill(0, $scc_count, 0);
for ($u = 0; $u < $scc_count; $u++) {
    foreach ($scc_g[$u] as $v) {
        $indeg[$v]++;
    }
}

$queue = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $scc_count; $i++) {
    if ($indeg[$i] == 0) $queue[] = $i;
}

$topo = [];
for ($head = 0; $head < count($queue); $head++) {
    $v = $queue[$head];
    $topo[] = $v;
    foreach ($scc_g[$v] as $to) {
        if (--$indeg[$to] == 0) {
            $queue[] = $to;
        }
    }
}

// DP over DAG
$has_assign = array_fill(0, $scc_count, false);
$has_use = array_fill(0, $scc_count, false);

foreach ($topo as $v) {
    if ($assign[$v]) $has_assign[$v] = true;
    if ($use[$v]) $has_use[$v] = true;
    foreach ($scc_g[$v] as $to) {
        if ($has_assign[$v]) $has_assign[$to] = true;
        if ($has_use[$v]) $has_use[$to] = true;
    }
}

// Determine interesting SCCs
$interesting_scc = array_fill(0, $scc_count, false);
for ($i = 0; $i < $scc_count; $i++) {
    if ($has_assign[$i] && $has_use[$i] && !$assign[$i]) {
        $interesting_scc[$i] = true;
    }
}

// Output per node
$out = [];
for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    $cid = $scc_id[$v];
    $out[] = $interesting_scc[$cid] ? '1' : '0';
}
echo implode(PHP_EOL, $out);
?>

<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$f = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', $line));

$adj = array_fill(0, $n, []);
$radj = array_fill(0, $n, []);

    fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $a, $b);
    $a--; $b--;
    $adj[$a][] = $b;
    $radj[$b][] = $a;
}

$interesting = array_fill(0, $n, 0);

// BFS from all use states (f[i]==2) on reverse graph
$queue = new SplQueue();
$inQueue = array_fill(0, $n, false);

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    if ($f[$i] == 2) {
        $queue->enqueue($i);
        $inQueue[$i] = true;
    }

while (!$queue->isEmpty()) {
    $v = $queue->dequeue();
    $interesting[$v] = 1;
    foreach ($radj[$v] as $u) {
        if ($f[$u] == 1) continue; // assignment breaks chain
        if (!$inQueue[$u]) {
            $inQueue[$u] = true;
            $queue->enqueue($u);
        }
    }
}

for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {

}

<?php
// Read n and m
list($n, $m) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

// Read actions
$actions = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
array_unshift($actions, 0); // 1-based indexing

$g = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []);
$rg = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []); // reversed graph

    list($a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line));
    $g[$a][] = $b;
    $rg[$b][] = $a;
}

// Step 1: find nodes reachable from any assign (f[i] == 1)
$reachableFromAssign = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$queue = [];

// Multi-source BFS from all assign nodes
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($actions[$i] == 1) {
        $reachableFromAssign[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}

for ($head = 0; $head < count($queue); $head++) {
    $v = $queue[$head];
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        if (!$reachableFromAssign[$to]) {
            $reachableFromAssign[$to] = true;
            $queue[] = $to;
        }
    }
}

// Step 2: find nodes that can reach any use (f[i] == 2) via paths with no assign (except maybe start)
$canReachUseNoAssign = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$queue = [];

// Multi-source BFS on reversed graph from all use nodes
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($actions[$i] == 2) {
        $canReachUseNoAssign[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}

for ($head = 0; $head < count($queue); $head++) {
    $v = $queue[$head];
    foreach ($rg[$v] as $from) {
        // We cannot pass through assign nodes (f[from] == 1), they can only be starting points
        if ($actions[$from] == 1) continue;
        if (!$canReachUseNoAssign[$from]) {
            $canReachUseNoAssign[$from] = true;
            $queue[] = $from;
        }
    }
}

// Step 3: determine interesting states
// A state is interesting if it lies on some path from an assign to a use with no other assign in between.
// That is: reachableFromAssign[i] && canReachUseNoAssign[i]
$out = [];
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $out[$i] = ($reachableFromAssign[$i] && $canReachUseNoAssign[$i]) ? 1 : 0;
}

// Output
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    echo $out[$i] . PHP_EOL;
}

    if ($f[$i] == 2) {
        $canReachUse[$i] = true;

<?php

list($n, $m) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

// Read actions
$f = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
array_unshift($f, 0); // 1-based

}

$fromAssign = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$queue = [];
$head = 0;

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($f[$i] == 1) {
        $fromAssign[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}

while ($head < count($queue)) {
    $v = $queue[$head++];
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        if (!$fromAssign[$to]) {
            $fromAssign[$to] = true;
            $queue[] = $to;
        }
    }
}

// Step 2: nodes that can reach any use (f[i] == 2), using reverse graph
$toUse = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$queue = [];
$head = 0;

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($f[$i] == 2) {
        $toUse[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}

while ($head < count($queue)) {
    $v = $queue[$head++];
    foreach ($rg[$v] as $from) {
        if (!$toUse[$from]) {
            $toUse[$from] = true;
            $queue[] = $from;
        }
    }
}

// Step 3: nodes that are on some path from assign to use
$onPath = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($fromAssign[$i] && $toUse[$i]) {
        $onPath[$i] = true;
    }
}

// Step 4: build subgraph of nodes onPath and find SCCs (Kosaraju)
$visited = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$order = [];

// DFS1 on subgraph
$stack = [];
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($onPath[$i] && !$visited[$i]) {
        // iterative DFS
        $stack[] = [$i, 0];
        $visited[$i] = true;
        while ($stack) {
            $top = array_pop($stack);
            $v = $top[0];
            $idx = $top[1];
            $adj = $g[$v];
            $len = count($adj);
            if ($idx < $len) {
                $stack[]([$v, $idx + 1]);
                $to = $adj[$idx];
                if ($onPath[$to] && !$visited[$to]) {
                    $visited[$to] = true;
                    $stack[]([$to, 0]);
                }
            } else {
                $order[] = $v;
            }
        }
    }

$compId = array_fill(0, $n + 1, -1);

    $v = $order[$i];
    if ($compId[$v] != -1) continue;

    $stack = [$v];
    $compId[$v] = $compCount;
    while ($stack) {
        $u = array_pop($stack);
        foreach ($rg[$u] as $to) {
            if ($onPath[$to] && $compId[$to] == -1) {
                $compId[$to] = $compCount;
                $stack[] = $to;
            }
        }
    }
    $compCount++;

$compHasUse = array_fill(0, $compCount, false);

    if (!$onPath[$i]) continue;
    $cid = $compId[$i];
    if ($f[$i] == 1) $compHasAssign[$cid] = true;
    if ($f[$i] == 2) $compHasUse[$cid] = true;

$compGraph = array_fill(0, $compCount, []);
$revCompGraph = array_fill(0, $compCount, []);

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    if (!$onPath[$v]) continue;
    $cv = $compId[$v];
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        if (!$onPath[$to]) continue;
        $cu = $compId[$to];
        if ($cv != $cu) {
            $compGraph[$cv][] = $cu;
            $revCompGraph[$cu][] = $cv;
        }
    }
}

for ($i = 0; $i < $compCount; $i++) {
    if ($compGraph[$i]) {
        $compGraph[$i] = array_values(array_unique($compGraph[$i]));
    }
    if ($revCompGraph[$i]) {
        $revCompGraph[$i] = array_values(array_unique($revCompGraph[$i]));
    }
}

// fromAssignComp
$fromAssignComp = array_fill(0, $compCount, false);
$queue = [];
$head = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $compCount; $i++) {
    if ($compHasAssign[$i]) {
        $fromAssignComp[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}
while ($head < count($queue)) {
    $c = $queue[$head++];
    foreach ($compGraph[$c] as $to) {
        if (!$fromAssignComp[$to]) {
            $fromAssignComp[$to] = true;
            $queue[] = $to;
        }
    }
}

// toUseComp
$toUseComp = array_fill(0, $compCount, false);
$queue = [];
$head = 0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $compCount; $i++) {
    if ($compHasUse[$i]) {
        $toUseComp[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}
while ($head < count($queue)) {
    $c = $queue[$head++];
    foreach ($revCompGraph[$c] as $from) {
        if (!$toUseComp[$from]) {
            $toUseComp[$from] = true;
            $queue[] = $from;
        }
    }
}

// Step 7: final result
$res = array_fill(1, $n, 0);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if (!$onPath[$i]) continue;
    $cid = $compId[$i];
    if ($fromAssignComp[$cid] && $toUseComp[$cid]) {
        $res[$i] = 1;
    }
}

// Output
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    echo $res[$i] . PHP_EOL;
}

<?php
// Read n and m
list($n, $m) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

// Read actions
$f = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
array_unshift($f, 0); // 1-based indexing

// Graphs
$g = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []);
$rg = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []); // reverse graph

for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    if ($line === '') { $i--; continue; }
    list($a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line));
    $g[$a][] = $b;
    $rg[$b][] = $a;
}

// Kosaraju to find SCCs
$visited = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$order = [];

function dfs1($v, &$g, &$visited, &$order) {
    $visited[$v] = true;
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        if (!$visited[$to]) dfs1($to, $g, $visited, $order);
    }
    $order[] = $v;
}

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if (!$visited[$i]) dfs1($i, $g, $visited, $order);
}

$comp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, -1);
$compCnt = 0;

function dfs2($v, $cl, &$rg, &$comp) {
    $comp[$v] = $cl;
    foreach ($rg[$v] as $to) {
        if ($comp[$to] == -1) dfs2($to, $cl, $rg, $comp);
    }
}

for ($i = count($order) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $v = $order[$i];
    if ($comp[$v] == -1) {
        dfs2($v, $compCnt, $rg, $comp);
        $compCnt++;
    }
}

// Build condensation DAG
$cg = array_fill(0, $compCnt, []);
$rcg = array_fill(0, $compCnt, []);
$hasEdge = [];

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    $cv = $comp[$v];
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        $cu = $comp[$to];
        if ($cv != $cu) {
            $key = $cv . ',' . $cu;
            if (!isset($hasEdge[$key])) {
                $hasEdge[$key] = true;
                $cg[$cv][] = $cu;
                $rcg[$cu][] = $cv;
            }
        }
    }
}

// Mark components with assignment and usage
$hasAssign = array_fill(0, $compCnt, false);
$hasUse = array_fill(0, $compCnt, false);

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    $c = $comp[$v];
    if ($f[$v] == 1) $hasAssign[$c] = true;
    if ($f[$v] == 2) $hasUse[$c] = true;
}

// DP: from assignment to usage without other assignments
$good = array_fill(0, $compCnt, false);

// Topological order of condensation DAG
$indeg = array_fill(0, $compCnt, 0);
for ($i = 0; $i < $compCnt; $i++) {
    foreach ($cg[$i] as $to) $indeg[$to]++;
}
$queue = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $compCnt; $i++) {
    if ($indeg[$i] == 0) $queue[] = $i;
}
$topo = [];
for ($qi = 0; $qi < count($queue); $qi++) {
    $v = $queue[$qi];
    $topo[] = $v;
    foreach ($cg[$v] as $to) {
        $indeg[$to]--;
        if ($indeg[$to] == 0) $queue[] = $to;
    }
}

// Forward DP: from assignments forward until another assignment
$canReachUse = array_fill(0, $compCnt, false);
$fromAssign = array_fill(0, $compCnt, false);

for ($i = 0; $i < $compCnt; $i++) {
    if ($hasAssign[$i]) {
        $fromAssign[$i] = true;
    }
}

foreach ($topo as $v) {
    if ($fromAssign[$v]) {
        if ($hasUse[$v]) $canReachUse[$v] = true;
        foreach ($cg[$v] as $to) {
            if (!$hasAssign[$to]) {
                if ($fromAssign[$to] == false) $fromAssign[$to] = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

// Backward DP: from usages backward until another assignment
$canReachAssign = array_fill(0, $compCnt, false);
$toUse = array_fill(0, $compCnt, false);

for ($i = 0; $i < $compCnt; $i++) {
    if ($hasUse[$i]) {
        $toUse[$i] = true;
    }
}

for ($i = count($topo) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $v = $topo[$i];
    if ($toUse[$v]) {
        if ($hasAssign[$v]) $canReachAssign[$v] = true;
        foreach ($rcg[$v] as $from) {
            if (!$hasAssign[$from]) {
                if ($toUse[$from] == false) $toUse[$from] = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

// A component is good if it's on some path from assign to use without other assigns
for ($i = 0; $i < $compCnt; $i++) {
    if ($fromAssign[$i] && $toUse[$i]) $good[$i] = true;
}

// Output per node
$out = [];
for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    $out[] = $good[$comp[$v]] ? '1' : '0';
}
echo implode(PHP_EOL, $out);
?>

<?php
// Read n and m
list($n, $m) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

// Read actions
$f = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
array_unshift($f, 0); // 1-based indexing

// Graphs
$g = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []);
$rg = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []); // reverse graph

for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    if ($line === '') { $i--; continue; }
    list($a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line));
    $g[$a][] = $b;
    $rg[$b][] = $a;
}

// Step 1: find nodes reachable from any assign (f[i] == 1)
$fromAssign = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$queue = [];

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($f[$i] == 1 && !$fromAssign[$i]) {
        $fromAssign[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}

for ($qi = 0; $qi < count($queue); $qi++) {
    $v = $queue[$qi];
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        if (!$fromAssign[$to]) {
            $fromAssign[$to] = true;
            $queue[] = $to;
        }
    }
}

// Step 2: find nodes that can reach any use (f[i] == 2) using reverse graph
$toUse = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$queue = [];

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($f[$i] == 2 && !$toUse[$i]) {
        $toUse[$i] = true;
        $queue[] = $i;
    }
}

for ($qi = 0; $qi < count($queue); $qi++) {
    $v = $queue[$qi];
    foreach ($rg[$v] as $from) {
        if (!$toUse[$from]) {
            $toUse[$from] = true;
            $queue[] = $from;
        }
    }
}

// Step 3: mark candidate nodes that lie on some path from assign to use
$candidate = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    if ($fromAssign[$i] && $toUse[$i]) {
        $candidate[$i] = true;
    }
}

// Step 4: build subgraph of candidate nodes and compute SCCs (Kosaraju)
$cg = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []);
$crg = array_fill(0, $n + 1, []);

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    if (!$candidate[$v]) continue;
    foreach ($g[$v] as $to) {
        if ($candidate[$to]) {
            $cg[$v][] = $to;
            $crg[$to][] = $v;
        }
    }
}

// First DFS order
$visited = array_fill(0, $n + 1, false);
$order = [];

function dfs1($v, &$cg, &$visited, &$order) {
    $visited[$v] = true;
    foreach ($cg[$v] as $to) {
        if (!$visited[$to]) dfs1($to, $cg, $visited, $order);
    }
    $order[] = $v;
}

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    if ($candidate[$v] && !$visited[$v]) {
        dfs1($v, $cg, $visited, $order);
    }
}

// Second DFS on reversed graph to get components
$compId = array_fill(0, $n + 1, -1);
$compCount = 0;

function dfs2($v, $cid, &$crg, &$compId) {
    $compId[$v] = $cid;
    foreach ($crg[$v] as $to) {
        if ($compId[$to] == -1) dfs2($to, $cid, $crg, $compId);
    }
}

for ($i = count($order) - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $v = $order[$i];
    if ($compId[$v] == -1) {
        dfs2($v, $compCount, $crg, $compId);
        $compCount++;
    }
}

// Info per component
$compHasAssign = array_fill(0, $compCount, false);
$compHasUse = array_fill(0, $compCount, false);

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    if (!$candidate[$v]) continue;
    $cid = $compId[$v];
    if ($f[$v] == 1) $compHasAssign[$cid] = true;
    if ($f[$v] == 2) $compHasUse[$cid] = true;
}

// Build condensation DAG
$dag = array_fill(0, $compCount, []);
$rad = array_fill(0, $compCount, []);

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    if (!$candidate[$v]) continue;
    $cv = $compId[$v];
    foreach ($cg[$v] as $to) {
        $cu = $compId[$to];
        if ($cv != $cu) {
            $dag[$cv][] = $cu;
            $rad[$cu][] = $cv;
        }
    }
}

// Remove duplicate edges in DAG
for ($i = 0; $i < $compCount; $i++) {
    if (count($dag[$i]) > 1) {
        $dag[$i] = array_values(array_unique($dag[$i]));
    }
    if (count($rad[$i]) > 1) {
        $rad[$i] = array_values(array_unique($rad[$i]));
    }
}

// DP: fromAssignComp and toUseComp on condensation DAG
$fromAssignComp = array_fill(0, $compCount, false);
$toUseComp = array_fill(0, $compCount, false);

// Topological order of condensation DAG (using order of components from Kosaraju)
$topo = range(0, $compCount - 1);

// Forward DP for fromAssignComp
for ($i = 0; $i < $compCount; $i++) {
    $c = $topo[$i];
    if ($compHasAssign[$c]) $fromAssignComp[$c] = true;
    foreach ($rad[$c] as $p) {
        if ($fromAssignComp[$p]) {
            $fromAssignComp[$c] = true;
            break;
        }
    }
}

// Backward DP for toUseComp
for ($i = $compCount - 1; $i >= 0; $i--) {
    $c = $topo[$i];
    if ($compHasUse[$c]) $toUseComp[$c] = true;
    foreach ($dag[$c] as $nxt) {
        if ($toUseComp[$nxt]) {
            $toUseComp[$c] = true;
            break;
        }
    }
}

// Final answer
$res = array_fill(1, $n, 0);

for ($v = 1; $v <= $n; $v++) {
    if (!$candidate[$v]) {
        $res[$v] = 0;
        continue;
    }
    $cid = $compId[$v];
    if ($fromAssignComp[$cid] && $toUseComp[$cid]) {
        $res[$v] = 1;
    } else {
        $res[$v] = 0;
    }
}

// Output
for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    echo $res[$i] . PHP_EOL;
}
?>
